name: Grand Genève
author: pierreggt
description: Map of the cross-border Grand Genève area (Switzerland/France), covering Lake Geneva in its entirety from Geneva to Lausanne, Vevey and Villeneuve on the Swiss shore, plus Annemasse, Annecy and the Pays de Gex on the French side. Real French INSEE and Swiss Federal Statistical Office data on both sides, with real cross-border commuter statistics. Sourced special demand points: Geneva Airport, University of Geneva, HUG, CERN, Geneva-Cornavin and Annemasse stations.
data_source: INSEE, OFS (Office fédéral de la statistique suisse)
